prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Bose Second Zone Remote - PMC2; brand: bose; description: Bose Second Zone Remote - PMC2/ Controls Lifestyle 38 Or 48 Media Center/ TV, VCR, Cable Box, Satellite Receiver/ Accesses Digitally Stored CDs In UMusic System; price: $149.00

Candidates:
1. name: Bose PMCII Remote Control; brand: BOSE; description: DVD Player, TV, VCR, Tuner, Amplifier, CD Player, Cable Box, Satellite Receiver, PVR (Personal Video Recorder) - 80 ft - DVD Player Remote; price: $145.37
2. name: Logitech Harmony 890 Advanced Universal Remote - 966193-0403; brand: Logitech; price: $248.90
3. name: Logitech Harmony One Advanced Universal Remote Control - 915-000035; brand: Logitech; description: Logitech Harmony One Advanced Universal Remote; price: $179.99
